name: Jihad
overview: The concept of Jihad, while not named explicitly in Scripture, can be understood through the lens of spiritual and earthly conflict as depicted in the provided verses. Jesus warns of fierce opposition from those who reject His reign, even to the point of violent resistance (Luke 19:27), and foretells persecution where believers will be harmed under the mistaken belief they are serving God (John 16:2). Ultimately, the true struggle is not merely physical but spiritual, against unseen forces of darkness and wickedness in high places (Ephesians 6:12), calling believers to recognize the deeper, spiritual battle behind outward hostilities.
